values.en: The affine embedding $\iota\colon\mathbb{R}^2\to\mathbb{P}^2_{\mathbb{R}}$, $\iota(x,y)=[x:y:1]$, is injective. Its image is the set of projective points admitting a representative $(X,Y,Z)$ with $Z\neq 0$, and on that image the inverse is $[X:Y:Z]\mapsto(X/Z,Y/Z)$.
values.zh-CN: 仿射嵌入 $\iota\colon\mathbb{R}^2\to\mathbb{P}^2_{\mathbb{R}}$，$\iota(x,y)=[x:y:1]$ 是单射。其像为具有 $Z\neq 0$ 的代表三元组 $(X,Y,Z)$ 的射影点集合，在该像上逆映射为 $[X:Y:Z]\mapsto(X/Z,Y/Z)$。
